description.value: RV-focused resort on sheltered Pedder Bay near Sooke, primarily catering to RVs and boaters with marina access; tent-camping suitability and facilities are unclear as the site was unreachable.

Most amenity details cannot be confirmed from the 404 page alone, but reservations and on-site food are evident from site navigation.
